b2-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Papers Say
b2-16-01.scenario: At the Café Meteor, Ady's editor asks him why he writes so sharply. Ady answers.
b2-16-01.prompt: As Ady, tell the editor what the papers say and what the truth is.
cues: Say what the papers say about the situation
b2-16-01.target: A lapok jó helyzetről beszélnek, holott az emberek nehezen élnek.
b2-16-01.english: The papers talk of a good situation, whereas in fact people are living with difficulty.
b2-16-01.canDo: I can use holott to expose a contradiction between an appearance and underlying reality

b2-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides
b2-16-02.scenario: At a table in the Café Meteor the editor asks Ady how the official papers and the independent paper see the country.
b2-16-02.prompt: As Ady, tell the editor what the official papers say and what you write.
cues: Say what the official papers say
Contrast it with what you write
b2-16-02.target: A hivatalos lapok szerint jó a helyzet. Ezzel szemben mi az igazat írjuk.
b2-16-02.english: According to the official papers the situation is good. In contrast, we write the truth.
b2-16-02.canDo: I can set up a formal counter-thesis using ezzel szemben and ellenben

b2-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: I Admit It, But
b2-16-03.scenario: In the café the editor tells Ady that he agrees with him, but he sees a danger for the paper.
b2-16-03.prompt: As the editor, tell Ady that you admit he is right, and say what you still fear.
cues: Say what you fear all the same
b2-16-03.target: Elismerem, hogy igazad van, mégis félek a cenzúrától.
b2-16-03.english: I admit that you are right, yet I fear the censorship.
b2-16-03.canDo: I can formulate strategic concessions using elismerem, hogy... mégis...

b2-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Empty Words
b2-16-04.scenario: Ady is angry about the way the official papers talk about the country. He tells the editor what kind of talk it is.
b2-16-04.prompt: As Ady, tell the editor what you think of the official talk.
cues: Say what kind of talk it is
Say there is a contradiction in it
b2-16-04.target: Ez a hivatalos beszéd csak álokoskodás, és ellentmondás van benne.
b2-16-04.english: This official talk is only sophistry, and there is a contradiction in it.
b2-16-04.canDo: I can identify and dissect common rhetorical fallacies in Hungarian

b2-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Editor Decides
b2-16-05.scenario: At the end of the evening in the Café Meteor the editor decides about the editorial and tells Ady.
b2-16-05.prompt: As the editor, tell Ady what you fear and what you will do.
cues: Say that the editorial will appear tomorrow
b2-16-05.target: Jóllehet félek a cenzúrától, a vezércikk holnap megjelenik.
b2-16-05.english: Although I fear the censorship, the editorial will appear tomorrow.
b2-16-05.canDo: I can structure an op-ed with an opening thesis, concession, and rebuttal

b2-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened at the Café
b2-16-consolidation.scenario: The next day a friend asks you what the papers say and what Ady and his editor talked about at the Café Meteor.
b2-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what the official papers say and what is true.
cues: Say what the official papers say
b2-16-consolidation.target: A hivatalos lapok jó helyzetről írnak, holott sok ember nehezen él.
b2-16-consolidation.english: The official papers write of a good situation, whereas in fact many people live with difficulty.
b2-16-consolidation.canDo: I can expose contradictions between illusion and reality using holott and csakhogy
